1960s album cover with drop shadow text

recipe.visualDefinition: A group of five men in light blue Civil War-style uniforms standing in a sunlit field of tall grass and yellow wildflowers, topped by bold, arched typography with deep black drop shadows.
coreVisualRelationships: Subjects are partially obscured by out-of-focus foreground flora
Typography is anchored to the top edge of the frame
Uniform color contrasts with the warm, natural tones of the field
Diagonal red-lined box provides a secondary focal point on the right
coreInvariants: Light blue military-style jackets with black trim and chevrons
Heavy black drop shadows on all primary display text
Soft-focus yellow wildflowers in the immediate foreground

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five subjects arranged horizontally across the mid-ground, waist-up view.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold, arched band name at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top text down to the faces of the band members, then following the diagonal red box on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The sky area behind the text and the dense floral foreground.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, sun-bleached saturation typical of 1960s film stock.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or high-chroma digital colors
Stick to earth tones and sky blues

characterSpecificRedesigns: Arched baseline for the main title
Condensed proportions for secondary track lists
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold arched display type paired with small, clean sans-serif blocks for track listings.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and bold presence of the main title.
Provides the necessary weight and vintage feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of five men in 1860s-style light blue military jackets standing in a field of tall grass and yellow wildflowers. The foreground should be out of focus with yellow flowers. Leave the top 25% of the image as clear sky for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in an arched path at the top using a bold white sans-serif with a thick black drop shadow. Add a diagonal red box on the right side with thin red text inside.

verificationChecks: Does the text have a heavy black drop shadow?
Are the subjects wearing matching blue uniforms?
Is there a soft-focus floral foreground?

mustAchieve: Authentic 1960s film grain and color grading
